body.system:
Choose exactly one bucket for the patient message:
1. SELF_CARE
2. ASYNC_PHYSICIAN
3. URGENT_ESCALATION

Medication refill → ASYNC_PHYSICIAN unless clear emergency/same-day red flags → URGENT_ESCALATION.

Use only findings stated in the message. An unreported finding is unknown, not absent. Choose SELF_CARE only when the supplied information supports no clinician assessment now. If missing information could materially change that decision, choose ASYNC_PHYSICIAN unless reported findings warrant URGENT_ESCALATION. Missing information alone does not establish an emergency.

Return only JSON with "disposition" (one exact bucket name) and "rationale" (short).

messages.content: An urgent care clinician examined my twisted ankle yesterday, said the x-rays showed no fracture, and gave me a sprain care plan. Today the pain and swelling are both better. I can walk normally, and have no new pain, numbness or skin change. I just want to know whether I can keep following that plan.
